summary: Implemented the surface as a 298-line self-contained HTML file. Renders deterministically at 1440x900. The packet delivered contradictory instructions: creative direction listed as an open decision while the authority block forbids creating one, with locks empty and no paths for any of the four declared inputs.

claims.claim: The packet listed creative direction as an open decision while forbidding the builder from creating a Direction, with locks empty.
The winning Direction's deliberation was not delivered, only its conclusion; no omission rule hides it.
The surface renders at 1440x900 and three consecutive captures produce an identical md5 (92e19bb92bfda959856977c6cc0922c3).
The file is self-contained: zero external CSS, JS or font requests; one external href to the repository.
Chromium --headless=new pins innerWidth to a ~500px floor, so a 375px screenshot is laid out at 500px and cropped, producing stable but wrong mobile evidence.

risks: The hero renders 41 plus the unit ms, which reads as more than the four-character contract term allows. Flagged rather than silently reinterpreted.
shot-375.png was produced under the headless width floor and must not be used as mobile evidence.
unresolved: gate build-health has no executor; the verification table is this role's own measurement
the four-character hero contract needs an explicit ruling on whether the unit counts
